_about: Maps each API Mega List category to the PurpClaw divisions and agents that should use them. Each category can be primary to one division and shared with others. Agents are the named workers in lib/agent_tower.js.

agents.purpose: Build and integrate agent systems, orchestration frameworks, autonomous workflows

ai.purpose: AI/ML models, fine-tuning, training data, inference endpoints, embeddings

automation.purpose: Workflow automation, scheduled jobs, RPA, browser automation, task runners

business.purpose: Business operations, contracts, compliance, governance, KPI tracking

devtools.purpose: Code review, CI/CD, linters, formatters, testing, deployment, IDE integrations

ecommerce.purpose: Product catalogs, pricing, inventory, checkout, Shopify/Amazon integrations

integrations.purpose: Connectors, sync engines, data pipelines, third-party service bridges

jobs.purpose: Job boards, hiring platforms, freelance marketplaces, recruitment scrapers

leadgen.purpose: Lead capture, contact enrichment, email finding, prospecting, list building

mcp.purpose: Model Context Protocol servers, tool registries, agent plumbing

news.purpose: News aggregation, RSS feeds, content monitoring, journalism scrapers

oss.purpose: Open source project discovery, GitHub/GitLab tools, package managers, license tracking

other.purpose: Miscellaneous utilities that don't fit other categories — engineering triage

realestate.purpose: Property listings, Zillow/Realtor scrapers, valuations, market analysis

seo.purpose: Search ranking, keyword research, backlink analysis, SERP scraping

social.purpose: Social platform scrapers (Twitter/LinkedIn/Instagram/TikTok), engagement tracking, posting

travel.purpose: Flight/hotel APIs, booking platforms, trip planning, geo data

videos.purpose: YouTube/TikTok scrapers, video metadata, transcription, video processing
